title: Kojima Productions' Physint Game Casts Bill Skarsgård in Lead Role
content: Hideo Kojima appeared on the "XBox Tokyo Game Show 2026" stream on Thursday and revealed updates for Kojima Productions ' planned OD KNOCK and PHYSINT games, including revealing Bill Skarsgård will be the lead actor for the PHYSINT game. The stream also revealed a visual for the game.
author: ANN

title: Crazy Taxi: World Tour Game Introduces Japan Map in New Video
content: Sega presented in a new video the Japan Map of its Crazy Taxi : World Tour , a new entry in its racing game series, during the "XBox Tokyo Game Show 2026" stream on Thursday. The game will launch for Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC via Steam and Microsoft Store in 2027.
author: ANN

title: Man-God Laughs at Rudy in Mushoku Tensei Season 3 Episode 13 Preview
content: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 revealed the Episode 13 preview images and synopsis ahead of its September 20 premiere. The anime has introduced the future Rudeus and set up a dark atmosphere for the rest of the season, with the upcoming episode set to reveal the contents of the future diary.
author: Anime Corner

title: Devils’ Crest Anime Unveils Additional Voice Cast Members
content: The production team for the upcoming Devils’ Crest anime has revealed the voice actors for four of the show’s characters. They also released several character and VA visuals alongside the news.
author: Anime Corner

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Reveals Ninth Ending Featuring "Suberidai" by Mori Tsubasa
content: Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its ninth ending, featuring the song “Suberidai” by Mori Tsubasa. The song was used in Episodes 102-114, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.
author: Anime Corner

content: Netmarble 's Solo Leveling : Karma game revealed a gameplay overview and cinematic story trailer for the game on Thursday at Tokyo Game Show. title: New Lollipop Chainsaw Game Announced for 2027 Release on PS5
content: Nada Holdings and Dragami Games announced a new game in the Lollipop Chainsaw franchise titled Lollipop Chainsaw 2 Back2Back during Tokyo Game Show on Thursday. The game will launch for the PlayStation 5 in 2027. Final Fantasy XV director Hajime Tabata is directing the game, with his JP Universe company developing.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Series The Remarried Empress Releases Main Trailer, Key Visual
content: Disney+ and Hulu released the main trailer and key visual on Wednesday for the webtoon- and web novel-based live-action series The Remarried Empress ahead of its November 4 debut .
author: ANN

title: Entergram Announces Koyo -RE-Nium Visual Novel Starring Hololive VTuber Hakui Koyori
content: Entergram opened a teaser website on Thursday to announce the KOYO -RE- NIUM visual novel starring hololive VTuber Hakui Koyori, who also supervises the game. No other details of the game were announced, and the official website will open on October 22.
author: ANN
